.github/workflows/deploy.yml:
name: Deploy

# The only workflow that deploys KC (D-195, INFRA-CI-3). Nothing deploys on
# push: a dev/main push runs CI, and when that CI run succeeds this workflow
# deploys exactly the commit CI tested — or, on dev, that commit's `[skip ci]`
# version-bump child, which inherits its parent's certification (TD-231,
# scripts/deploy-target.mjs).
#
#   dev  → supabase-dev + cloudflare-dev, automatic.
#   main → one approval click by the owner on the `production` environment,
#          then supabase-prod + cloudflare-prod.
#
# Order: resolve → preflight (supabase + web) → approve (prod) → DB (backup on
# prod, dry-run, apply) → Edge Functions → web baseline (prod) → web → smoke →
# tag (prod). On prod, a failed functions/web/smoke stage rolls web back to
# the recorded Cloudflare deployment and functions to the previous release
# tag, then re-runs the smoke (deploy-rollback.yml). The DB is forward-fix
# only. Each stage is a reusable deploy-*.yml workflow with no trigger of its
# own (scripts/check-deploy-isolation.mjs enforces that statically), and every
# job that changes an environment starts with the deploy guard
# (scripts/deploy-guard.mjs): it fails unless this file on main called it and,
# for prod, the release was approved in the current run attempt and is still
# the main tip — so "Re-run failed jobs" cannot redeploy without a new click
# ("Re-run all jobs" asks for one).
#
# Environments: `production` holds only the required reviewer (the owner) and
# no secrets; one job uses it, so a release costs exactly one click. The
# secrets live on supabase-{dev,prod} and cloudflare-{dev,prod}, which must
# have NO reviewers (each would add a click). Restrict the prod environments
# and `production` to the `main` branch: `workflow_run` jobs run on the default
# branch, and that restriction stops a dispatch from any other ref using them.
#
# `workflow_run` always runs this file as it is on the default branch (main),
# so deploy-pipeline changes take effect only after a release. Dispatch runs
# use the dispatched ref's copy and are limited to dev and main.

# Two `workflow_run` sources. `CI` is the real one. `Bump app version on
# merge` (bump-version-on-merge.yml) is a wake-up only: its `[skip ci]` bump
# commit never gets a CI run, so when the merge's CI run finishes BEFORE the
# bump lands, CI deploys the merge and nothing would ever deploy the bump.
# The bump run's completion re-runs the resolver, which deploys the bump
# child only if the merge's CI gate is already green (and otherwise leaves it
# to the CI run's completion). Both are matched by name; deploy-target.mjs
# accepts only runs of these two workflow files and always reads the
# certification from ci.yml's runs, never from the triggering run.
#
# dev push (TD #1430). `workflow_run` only fires for a file on the default
# branch (main), so until a release carries deploy.yml no dev push would ever
# deploy kc-dev. A push to dev therefore also starts this workflow from dev's
# own copy: resolve waits for that commit's push CI run to finish, then judges
# it exactly like a dispatch (same CI-gate and bump-inheritance rules). Push is
# dev-only — prod still deploys only through workflow_run/dispatch on main with
# the owner's approval. A `[skip ci]` bump push starts nothing; the merge's
# push run picks up the bump child once CI is green.
on:
  push:
    branches: [dev]
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI, Bump app version on merge]
    types: [completed]
    branches: [dev, main]
  workflow_dispatch:

# One deploy per environment at a time; a running deploy is never cancelled.
# Runs that cannot deploy (PR events, failures) get a unique group so they
# never displace a queued real deploy. A bump run shares its branch's group
# with CI-triggered deploys, so they never run concurrently.
concurrency:
  group: >-
    deploy-${{ (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event_name == 'push' || (github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' && github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success'))
    && (github.event.workflow_run.head_branch || github.ref_name) || format('noop-{0}', github.run_id) }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions: {}

jobs:
  # Which commit, which target, and proof that CI gated it (directly, or for a
  # dev version-bump commit through its parent). The judge,
  # scripts/deploy-target.mjs, runs from this workflow's own commit
  # (github.workflow_sha: main for workflow_run), never from the judged
  # commit. On prod it also requires a merged dev → main PR of this repo for
  # the commit, app/VERSION above the latest v* tag, and no v<VERSION> tag on
  # another commit; and it finds the previous release for rollback.
  resolve:
    name: resolve target
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event_name == 'push' || (github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' && github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 75
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      deploy: ${{ steps.target.outputs.deploy }}
      target: ${{ steps.target.outputs.target }}
      sha: ${{ steps.target.outputs.sha }}
      previous_sha: ${{ steps.release.outputs.previous_sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
          path: .trusted
          sparse-checkout: scripts/deploy-target.mjs
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          persist-credentials: false
      # dev push only: wait (max ~70 min) for this commit's push CI run to
      # complete; the judge below then requires its CI gate to be green.
      - name: Wait for the push CI run (dev push)
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for _ in $(seq 1 140); do
            st=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/workflows/ci.yml/runs?head_sha=$SHA&event=push&per_page=5" \
              --jq '[.workflow_runs[].status] | if length == 0 then "none" elif all(. == "completed") then "completed" else "running" end')
            echo "CI for $SHA: $st"
            [ "$st" = completed ] && exit 0
            sleep 30
          done
          echo "::error::CI for $SHA did not complete in time"; exit 1
      - name: Resolve and verify the CI gate
        id: target
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          WORKFLOW_RUN: ${{ toJSON(github.event.workflow_run) }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node .trusted/scripts/deploy-target.mjs
      # The judged commit with tags, for its app/VERSION and the release tags.
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        if: steps.target.outputs.deploy == 'true' && steps.target.outputs.target == 'prod'
        with:
          ref: ${{ steps.target.outputs.sha }}
          path: release
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Release version and tag checks (prod)
        id: release
        if: steps.target.outputs.deploy == 'true' && steps.target.outputs.target == 'prod'
        working-directory: release
        env:
          SHA: ${{ steps.target.outputs.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/release-version.mjs tag-plan "$SHA" | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/plan"
          # A re-run of an already tagged release is the only case where
          # VERSION may equal the latest tag.
          if grep -qx 'action=create' "$RUNNER_TEMP/plan"; then node scripts/release-version.mjs check-bump; fi
          {
            echo "### Release $(cat app/VERSION) — \`$SHA\`"
            echo "Approve the \`production\` environment to deploy it."
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  # Secrets present and pointing at the target's projects (deploy-preflight.yml).
  preflight:
    name: preflight
    needs: resolve
    if: needs.resolve.outputs.deploy == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/deploy-preflight.yml
    with:
      target: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.target }}
      sha: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.sha }}
    secrets: inherit

  # The owner's one click. Fails closed if `production` has no required
  # reviewer: the run's approvals must include one for this environment.
  approve:
    name: approve release
    needs: [resolve, preflight]
    if: needs.resolve.outputs.target == 'prod'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    environment:
      name: production
      url: ${{ vars.KC_PROD_URL }}
    permissions:
      actions: read
    outputs:
      attempt: ${{ steps.approved.outputs.attempt }}
    steps:
      - name: Confirm a reviewer approved this run
        id: approved
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          approvers=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/approvals" \
            --jq '[.[] | select(.state == "approved" and any(.environments[]; .name == "production")) | .user.login] | join(",")')
          if [ -z "$approvers" ]; then
            echo "::error::The production environment let this run through without an approval. Add the owner as its required reviewer (Settings → Environments → production)."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Release approved by $approvers."
          # Stages refuse to run unless this equals their own run_attempt, so a
          # "Re-run failed jobs" attempt cannot reuse this approval.
          echo "attempt=$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  db:
    name: database
    needs: [resolve, preflight, approve]
    # Explicit: on prod `approve` must succeed; on dev it is skipped.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.preflight.result == 'success'
      && (needs.approve.result == 'success' || (needs.approve.result == 'skipped' && needs.resolve.outputs.target == 'dev'))
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/deploy-db.yml
    with:
      target: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.target }}
      sha: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.sha }}
      approved_attempt: ${{ needs.approve.outputs.attempt }}
    secrets: inherit

  functions:
    name: edge functions
    needs: [resolve, approve, db]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.db.result == 'success' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/deploy-functions.yml
    with:
      target: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.target }}
      sha: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.sha }}
      release_sha: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.sha }}
      approved_attempt: ${{ needs.approve.outputs.attempt }}
    secrets: inherit

  # Records the Cloudflare deployment serving prod right before the web
  # deploy replaces it; rollback-web returns to it.
  web-baseline:
    name: web baseline (prod)
    needs: [resolve, functions]
    if: needs.resolve.outputs.target == 'prod'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    environment: cloudflare-prod
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      previous_id: ${{ steps.current.outputs.previous_id }}
      attempt: ${{ steps.current.outputs.attempt }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.sha }}
          sparse-checkout: scripts
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Record the live production deployment
        id: current
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          CF_PAGES_PROJECT: karma-community
        run: |
          node scripts/cloudflare-pages.mjs current main
          echo "attempt=$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  web:
    name: web
    needs: [resolve, approve, functions, web-baseline]
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.functions.result == 'success'
      && (needs.web-baseline.result == 'success' || (needs.web-baseline.result == 'skipped' && needs.resolve.outputs.target == 'dev'))
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/deploy-web.yml
    with:
      target: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.target }}
      sha: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.sha }}
      approved_attempt: ${{ needs.approve.outputs.attempt }}
    secrets: inherit

  smoke:
    name: smoke
    needs: [resolve, web]
    # Explicit: the default success() also needs every upstream job, and on dev
    # the prod-only approve/web-baseline jobs are always skipped.
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.web.result == 'success' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/deploy-smoke.yml
    with:
      target: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.target }}
      sha: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.sha }}
    secrets: inherit

  # vX.Y.Z tag + GitHub Release on the released commit (deploy-tag.yml).
  tag:
    name: tag release
    needs: [resolve, approve, smoke]
    if: needs.resolve.outputs.target == 'prod'
    permissions:
      contents: write
      actions: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/deploy-tag.yml
    with:
      sha: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.sha }}
      approved_attempt: ${{ needs.approve.outputs.attempt }}

  # Prod only, when functions, web or smoke failed after the approval: web
  # back to the deployment web-baseline recorded (empty when the web stage
  # never started), functions back to the previous release tag — unless the
  # release applied migrations, which demands a forward-fix instead.
  rollback:
    name: rollback (prod)
    needs: [resolve, approve, db, functions, web-baseline, web, smoke]
    if: >-
      always() && needs.resolve.outputs.target == 'prod'
      && (needs.functions.result == 'failure' || needs.web.result == 'failure' || needs.smoke.result == 'failure')
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/deploy-rollback.yml
    with:
      sha: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.sha }}
      previous_sha: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.previous_sha }}
      previous_web_id: ${{ needs.web-baseline.outputs.previous_id }}
      baseline_attempt: ${{ needs.web-baseline.outputs.attempt }}
      approved_attempt: ${{ needs.approve.outputs.attempt }}
      applied_migrations: ${{ needs.db.outputs.applied_migrations }}
    secrets: inherit
.github/workflows/deploy-db.yml:
name: DB deploy

# Database stage of the deploy pipeline (D-195, INFRA-CI-3). Called only by
# deploy.yml after preflight (and, for prod, after the owner's approval); it
# has no trigger of its own. Both jobs start with the deploy guard
# (.github/actions/deploy-guard), which fails unless the caller is deploy.yml
# and, on prod, the release is approved in this run attempt and still current.
#
#   backup   prod only: an encrypted `supabase db dump` (roles, schema, data)
#            taken before migrating, when supabase/migrations changed since
#            the last release tag. Storage objects (avatars, post images) are
#            NOT included. Stored as a 14-day workflow artifact for a manual
#            restore (docs/SSOT/OPERATOR_RUNBOOK.md "Restore a pre-migration
#            backup"). DB changes are forward-fix only.
#   migrate  counts the pending migrations (output `applied_migrations`, so a
#            failed release after a schema change skips the code rollback),
#            then dry-runs and applies them. On prod `db push` runs WITHOUT
#            --include-all, so the CLI refuses when the remote has a version
#            with no local file (remote ahead) or a local migration sorts
#            before the last applied one (out of order). Dev keeps
#            --include-all.
#
# Secrets come from the job's GitHub Environment (supabase-dev / supabase-prod;
# neither has reviewers — the approval click lives on `production`):
# SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN, SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD, SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF, and on
# prod the variable BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENT.

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      target:
        description: dev or prod
        type: string
        required: true
      sha:
        description: Exact commit to deploy
        type: string
        required: true
      approved_attempt:
        description: run_attempt in which the release was approved (empty on dev)
        type: string
        required: true
    outputs:
      applied_migrations:
        description: Number of migrations this run applied
        value: ${{ jobs.migrate.outputs.applied }}

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

jobs:
  backup:
    name: backup (prod)
    if: inputs.target == 'prod'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    environment: supabase-prod
    env:
      KC_SAFE_VAULT_SYNC: reveal-v1
      SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
      SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD }}
      SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF }}
      BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENT: ${{ vars.BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENT }}
      KC_PROD_SCHEMA_MODE: ${{ vars.KC_PROD_SCHEMA_MODE }}
      SHA: ${{ inputs.sha }}
    steps:
      # The guard comes from deploy.yml's own commit, not the deployed one.
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
          path: .deploy-guard
          sparse-checkout: |
            .github/actions/deploy-guard
            scripts/deploy-guard.mjs
            scripts/release-version.mjs
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.deploy-guard/.github/actions/deploy-guard
        with:
          target: prod
          release-sha: ${{ inputs.sha }}
          approved-attempt: ${{ inputs.approved_attempt }}

      # Full history + tags: the diff against the last release tag needs both.
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc

      - name: Preflight (fails closed without the backup key)
        run: node scripts/deploy-preflight.mjs supabase prod

      - name: Did migrations change since the last release?
        id: changed
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/release-version.mjs latest > "$RUNNER_TEMP/latest"
          last_sha=$(sed -n 's/^sha=//p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/latest")
          if [ -z "$last_sha" ]; then
            echo "No release tag yet; backing up."
            echo "dump=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif git diff --quiet "$last_sha" "$SHA" -- supabase/migrations; then
            echo "No migration changes since $last_sha; no backup needed."
            echo "dump=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "dump=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-supabase-cli
        if: steps.changed.outputs.dump == 'true'

      - name: Install age
        if: steps.changed.outputs.dump == 'true'
        run: sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq age >/dev/null

      # Each dump streams straight into age, so plaintext (PII) never touches
      # the disk or the log; only ciphertext is written and uploaded.
      - name: Dump roles, schema and data, encrypted
        if: steps.changed.outputs.dump == 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          supabase link --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" --yes >/dev/null
          out="$RUNNER_TEMP/backup"
          mkdir -p "$out"
          supabase db dump --linked --role-only | age -r "$BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENT" -o "$out/roles.sql.age"
          supabase db dump --linked | age -r "$BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENT" -o "$out/schema.sql.age"
          supabase db dump --linked --data-only --use-copy | age -r "$BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENT" -o "$out/data.sql.age"
          for f in "$out"/*.age; do
            test -s "$f" || { echo "::error::empty backup file $(basename "$f")"; exit 1; }
          done
          ls -l "$out"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        if: steps.changed.outputs.dump == 'true'
        with:
          name: prod-db-backup-${{ inputs.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/backup/
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: error

  migrate:
    name: migrations · ${{ inputs.target }}
    needs: backup
    # `backup` is skipped on dev and must succeed on prod.
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && (needs.backup.result == 'success' || (needs.backup.result == 'skipped' && inputs.target == 'dev')) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    environment: supabase-${{ inputs.target }}
    outputs:
      applied: ${{ steps.pending.outputs.pending }}
    env:
      TARGET: ${{ inputs.target }}
      KC_SAFE_VAULT_SYNC: reveal-v1
      SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
      SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD }}
      SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF }}
      BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENT: ${{ vars.BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENT }}
      KC_PROD_SCHEMA_MODE: ${{ vars.KC_PROD_SCHEMA_MODE }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
          path: .deploy-guard
          sparse-checkout: |
            .github/actions/deploy-guard
            scripts/deploy-guard.mjs
            scripts/release-version.mjs
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.deploy-guard/.github/actions/deploy-guard
        with:
          target: ${{ inputs.target }}
          release-sha: ${{ inputs.sha }}
          approved-attempt: ${{ inputs.approved_attempt }}

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc

      - name: Preflight (secrets present, project ref matches the target)
        run: node scripts/deploy-preflight.mjs supabase "$TARGET"

      # The CLI silently skips a file without a number, so an unnumbered migration would ship
      # the app without its schema. The post-merge numbering commit must have run first.
      - name: No migration is still waiting for its number
        run: |
          if pending=$(node scripts/migration-ids.mjs list); then exit 0; fi
          echo "::error::Unnumbered migrations: $pending (the numbering commit on dev has not landed)"
          exit 1

      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-supabase-cli

      - name: Retrieve and authenticate the exact Vault key before DB changes
        run: node scripts/deploy-service-key.mjs --prepare "$TARGET"

      - name: Link to remote project
        run: supabase link --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" --yes

      - name: Preserve the existing Vault caller before any DB mutation
        run: node scripts/deploy-service-key.mjs --verify-existing "$TARGET"

      # db-connect-retry: retries only a failed connect to the pooler (no SQL ran);
      # Deploy 43502416446 / 43505342327 went red on a pooler timeout while kc-dev was healthy.
      - name: Count pending migrations
        id: pending
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/db-connect-retry.mjs -- supabase migration list --linked --yes | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/migrations.txt"
          node scripts/check-migration-drift.mjs --count-pending "$RUNNER_TEMP/migrations.txt"

      # D-228: refuse a prod push unless KC_PROD_SCHEMA_MODE allows this tree.
      # Default (unset) is block. Defense in depth on top of deploy-preflight.
      - name: Prod schema mode (D-228)
        if: inputs.target == 'prod'
        run: node scripts/check-prod-schema-mode.mjs

      # Prod omits --include-all so out-of-order or remote-ahead histories fail
      # here, before anything is applied.
      - name: Dry-run push
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          flags=(--linked --yes)
          if [ "$TARGET" = dev ]; then flags+=(--include-all); fi
          node scripts/db-connect-retry.mjs -- supabase db push --dry-run "${flags[@]}"

      - name: Apply migrations
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          flags=(--linked --yes)
          if [ "$TARGET" = dev ]; then flags+=(--include-all); fi
          node scripts/db-connect-retry.mjs -- supabase db push "${flags[@]}"

      # A fresh database (the ledger was empty before this run: the first prod release, or a
      # rebuilt kc-dev) gets the reference + content seed once, right after the schema, so every
      # table the seed fills exists (on kc-dev the content seed once ran before 0024 and left the
      # world links/knowledge empty). Not on later deploys: the loaders write a row whenever it
      # differs from the CSV, which would undo edits made in the app. Idempotent; no demo data,
      # no e2e users, no secrets (supabase/seed/*/README.md).
      - name: Seed a fresh database (reference + content)
        if: steps.pending.outputs.fresh == 'true'
        env:
          PGPASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          url="$(cat supabase/.temp/pooler-url)"
          case "$url" in *"$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF"*) ;; *) echo "::error::pooler address is not the target project's; refusing."; exit 1 ;; esac
          echo "── reference ──"
          REFERENCE_DB_URL="$url" supabase/seed/reference/load.sh
          echo "── content ──"
          CONTENT_DB_URL="$url" supabase/seed/content/load.sh

      # Vault caller and URL were verified before migrations. Do not rewrite
      # either value: concurrent rotations must not be overwritten by a deploy.

      # The admin portal's Demo data screen (FR-ADMIN-031) calls RPCs of a dev-only seed
      # (supabase/seed/demo) that is not a migration, so nothing else brings it to kc-dev. It is
      # installed here on every dev deploy, right after the schema it reads: the tools always
      # match `dev`, and a rebuilt kc-dev has them at once. load.sql also sets the dev marker that
      # allows "Show demo data"; without a password it creates no demo data. Never on prod: the
      # step is skipped for any other target and refuses any project but kc-dev.
      - name: Demo-data tools (kc-dev only)
        if: inputs.target == 'dev'
        env:
          PGPASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD }}
          KC_DEV_REF: enbqriuxvvuontiwslun
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" != "$KC_DEV_REF" ]; then
            echo "::error::the dev target is not kc-dev; refusing to install the demo-data tools."; exit 1
          fi
          url="$(cat supabase/.temp/pooler-url)"
          case "$url" in *"$KC_DEV_REF"*) ;; *) echo "::error::pooler address is not kc-dev's; refusing."; exit 1 ;; esac
          psql "$url" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --single-transaction -qAt \
            -c "select set_config('kc.seed_target', 'dev', false)" -f supabase/seed/demo/load.sql

      # The weekly anonymized copy of production (FR-ADMIN-037) lands through a dev-only seed
      # (supabase/seed/prod-copy) for the same reason, and is installed the same way: on every
      # dev deploy, after the schema it writes, guarded to kc-dev. load.sql sets the marker that
      # lets a copy be applied; it copies nothing (the Production copy workflow does, weekly).
      - name: Production-copy tools (kc-dev only)
        if: inputs.target == 'dev'
        env:
          PGPASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD }}
          KC_DEV_REF: enbqriuxvvuontiwslun
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" != "$KC_DEV_REF" ]; then
            echo "::error::the dev target is not kc-dev; refusing to install the production-copy tools."; exit 1
          fi
          url="$(cat supabase/.temp/pooler-url)"
          case "$url" in *"$KC_DEV_REF"*) ;; *) echo "::error::pooler address is not kc-dev's; refusing."; exit 1 ;; esac
          psql "$url" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --single-transaction -qAt \
            -c "select set_config('kc.seed_target', 'dev', false)" -f supabase/seed/prod-copy/load.sql

      # After a fresh schema the pg_cron launcher was once seen idle on kc-dev (no
      # cron.job_run_details rows for an hour, until a new job was scheduled). Wait up to three
      # minutes for a run; if none, schedule and drop a throwaway job to wake the launcher, then
      # require a run within two more minutes.
      - name: pg_cron runs after a fresh schema
        if: steps.pending.outputs.fresh == 'true'
        env:
          PGPASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          url="$(cat supabase/.temp/pooler-url)"
          case "$url" in *"$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF"*) ;; *) echo "::error::pooler address is not the target project's; refusing."; exit 1 ;; esac
          start="$(psql "$url" -qAt -c "select now()")"
          # psql expands :'s' only in input it reads, never in -c, hence the here-string.
          runs() { psql "$url" -qAt -v s="$start" <<< "select count(*) from cron.job_run_details where start_time > :'s'::timestamptz"; }
          echo "cron jobs: $(psql "$url" -qAt -c 'select count(*) from cron.job where active')"
          for _ in $(seq 18); do [ "$(runs)" -gt 0 ] && { echo "pg_cron is running ($(runs) runs)"; exit 0; }; sleep 10; done
          echo "::warning::no pg_cron run in 3 minutes; waking the launcher with a throwaway job"
          psql "$url" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -qAt -c "select cron.schedule('zz_deploy_wake', '* * * * *', 'select 1')" >/dev/null
          for _ in $(seq 12); do [ "$(runs)" -gt 0 ] && break; sleep 10; done
          psql "$url" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -qAt -c "select cron.unschedule('zz_deploy_wake')" >/dev/null
          [ "$(runs)" -gt 0 ] || { echo "::error::pg_cron still runs nothing after the wake-up job"; exit 1; }
          echo "pg_cron is running ($(runs) runs)"

      - name: Remove temporary verified credential
        if: always()
        run: rm -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/kc-verified-service-key"
.github/workflows/deploy-functions.yml:
name: Edge Functions deploy

# Edge Functions stage of the deploy pipeline (D-195, INFRA-CI-3). Called only
# by deploy.yml: after the DB stage, and again on a failed prod release to
# redeploy the previous release tag's functions (rollback). No push or manual
# trigger; to redeploy dev, dispatch the Deploy workflow on `dev`.
#
# Deploys every function scripts/edge-functions.mjs lists (all of
# supabase/functions except shared code, the LOCAL_ONLY set and the
# NOT_DEPLOYED set, both defined in that script) to the target project, so the remote cannot drift behind the branch (TD-53), then
# checks the project lists each one as ACTIVE. The deploy smoke probes the
# ones that can be probed without side effects. The job starts with the
# deploy guard (.github/actions/deploy-guard).
#
# Environment supabase-<target> (no reviewers): SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN,
# SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD, SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF; optional variable
# PUBLIC_RESEARCH_ALLOWED_ORIGINS (Survey B CORS allowlist, synced as a
# function secret); optional secret EDGE_SENTRY_DSN (G41, D-202: synced as
# SENTRY_DSN + SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT + SENTRY_RELEASE; without it every function
# reports errors to its logs only).

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      target:
        description: dev or prod
        type: string
        required: true
      sha:
        description: Exact commit whose functions to deploy
        type: string
        required: true
      release_sha:
        description: The release being deployed (differs from sha only in a rollback)
        type: string
        required: true
      approved_attempt:
        description: run_attempt in which the release was approved (empty on dev)
        type: string
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

jobs:
  deploy:
    name: functions · ${{ inputs.target }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    environment: supabase-${{ inputs.target }}
    env:
      TARGET: ${{ inputs.target }}
      KC_SAFE_VAULT_SYNC: reveal-v1
      SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
      SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD }}
      SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF }}
      BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENT: ${{ vars.BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENT }}
      # The supabase preflight also runs the D-228 prod schema-mode check
      # (scripts/deploy-preflight.mjs), so it needs the same variable as deploy-db.yml.
      KC_PROD_SCHEMA_MODE: ${{ vars.KC_PROD_SCHEMA_MODE }}
      EDGE_SENTRY_DSN: ${{ secrets.EDGE_SENTRY_DSN }}
    steps:
      # The guard comes from deploy.yml's own commit, not the deployed one.
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
          path: .deploy-guard
          sparse-checkout: |
            .github/actions/deploy-guard
            scripts/deploy-guard.mjs
            scripts/release-version.mjs
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.deploy-guard/.github/actions/deploy-guard
        with:
          target: ${{ inputs.target }}
          release-sha: ${{ inputs.release_sha }}
          approved-attempt: ${{ inputs.approved_attempt }}

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc

      # Pins the project ref per target, so functions never land on the wrong project.
      - name: Preflight (secrets present, project ref matches the target)
        run: node scripts/deploy-preflight.mjs supabase "$TARGET"

      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-supabase-cli

      # Before the deploy, so new function instances start with the current
      # value. Passed through env: a variable is data, never script text.
      - name: Sync public-research CORS origins
        if: vars.PUBLIC_RESEARCH_ALLOWED_ORIGINS != ''
        env:
          ORIGINS: ${{ vars.PUBLIC_RESEARCH_ALLOWED_ORIGINS }}
        run: supabase secrets set --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" "PUBLIC_RESEARCH_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=$ORIGINS"

      # G41 / D-202: every function reports errors through _shared/observability.
      # The environment name is the deploy target (dev | prod); the release is the
      # commit being deployed. Secrets are referenced by name only.
      - name: Sync Sentry error-reporting secrets
        if: env.EDGE_SENTRY_DSN != ''
        env:
          RELEASE_SHA: ${{ inputs.release_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          supabase secrets set --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" \
            "SENTRY_DSN=$EDGE_SENTRY_DSN" \
            "SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT=$TARGET" \
            "SENTRY_RELEASE=functions@${RELEASE_SHA::12}"

      # #2452: every worker checks its caller against SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, a
      # default secret the platform sets per function version. If the project's
      # service_role key is rotated or re-issued, deployed functions keep comparing
      # against the old string until their next deploy, and a
      # SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY secret saved while the SUPABASE_ prefix was still
      # allowed shadows the platform value and can never be edited, only removed
      # (the prefix is reserved now, so writing the key back is impossible by
      # design). Heal both here: remove a shadow, matching or stale, then the
      # deploy below refreshes every function's environment - the same way
      # deploy-db.yml rewrites the kc_service_role_key Vault secret for the
      # database jobs. SUPABASE_ANON_KEY would shadow the same way; nothing uses
      # a saved copy of it today.
      - name: Drop a stale service-role key shadow (#2452)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          key="$(supabase projects api-keys --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" -o json | jq -r '[.[] | select(.name == "service_role" or .id == "service_role")][0].api_key // empty')"
          [ -n "$key" ] || { echo "::error::no service_role key returned for the target project"; exit 1; }
          echo "::add-mask::$key"
          shadow="$(supabase secrets list --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" -o json | jq -r '[.[] | select(.name == "SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")][0].digest // empty')"
          if [ -z "$shadow" ]; then
            echo "no SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY shadow: the platform-managed key applies."
          elif [ "$shadow" = "$(printf %s "$key" | sha256sum | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" ]; then
            echo "SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY shadow matches the current key; removing it so the platform manages the value."
            supabase secrets unset --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
          else
            echo "::warning::SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY shadow is stale: its digest differs from the current service_role key. Removing it."
            supabase secrets unset --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
          fi

      # --use-api bundles server-side (no Docker); verify_jwt per function
      # comes from supabase/config.toml.
      - name: Deploy every function
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          names=$(node scripts/edge-functions.mjs)
          for name in $names; do
            echo "::group::$name"
            supabase functions deploy "$name" --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" --use-api
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done

      # A function that failed to deploy is not ACTIVE; this also covers the
      # functions the smoke has no probe for.
      - name: Every function is ACTIVE
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          supabase functions list --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" -o json > "$RUNNER_TEMP/functions.json"
          node scripts/edge-functions.mjs --verify-active "$RUNNER_TEMP/functions.json"
.github/workflows/deploy-preflight.yml:
name: Deploy preflight

# First stage of the deploy pipeline, called only by deploy.yml before the
# approval and before anything changes (D-195, INFRA-CI-3). Read-only: each job
# reads one GitHub Environment's secrets (a job can read only one) and fails
# closed via scripts/deploy-preflight.mjs when one is missing or points at the
# wrong project.

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      target:
        description: dev or prod
        type: string
        required: true
      sha:
        description: Commit being deployed (its scripts run the checks)
        type: string
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  # Every Supabase secret present and pointing at the target's project; the
  # project is ACTIVE_HEALTHY; on prod the backup key is set.
  supabase:
    name: preflight · supabase
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    environment: supabase-${{ inputs.target }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
      - name: Check Supabase secrets
        env:
          KC_SAFE_VAULT_SYNC: reveal-v1
          TARGET: ${{ inputs.target }}
          SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
          SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD }}
          SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF }}
          BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENT: ${{ vars.BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENT }}
          KC_PROD_SCHEMA_MODE: ${{ vars.KC_PROD_SCHEMA_MODE }}
        run: node scripts/deploy-preflight.mjs supabase "$TARGET"

  # Cloudflare + web build settings; on prod also that `main` is the Pages
  # production branch (else the deploy would only create a preview).
  web:
    name: preflight · web
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    environment: cloudflare-${{ inputs.target }}
    env:
      TARGET: ${{ inputs.target }}
      CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
      CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
      CF_PAGES_PROJECT: karma-community
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
      - name: Check web secrets and URL
        env:
          EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL }}
          EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ${{ secrets.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY }}
          EXPO_PUBLIC_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ secrets.EXPO_PUBLIC_ENVIRONMENT }}
          WEB_URL: ${{ inputs.target == 'prod' && vars.KC_PROD_URL || vars.DEV_WEB_URL }}
        run: node scripts/deploy-preflight.mjs web "$TARGET"
      - name: Check the Pages production branch (prod)
        if: env.TARGET == 'prod'
        run: node scripts/cloudflare-pages.mjs current main
.github/workflows/seed-kc-dev.yml:
name: Seed KC dev

# Manual only. Loads the versioned seeds into the KC dev Supabase project (kc-dev) over a
# direct Postgres connection (the loaders use \copy). Never targets prod: the environment is
# fixed to supabase-dev and the project ref is checked before anything runs.
#
#   reference   cities, streets, road junctions            supabase/seed/reference/load.sh
#   content     organization links, legal texts, surveys,  supabase/seed/content/load.sh
#               the platform organization
#   e2e-users   user1 … user4 @seed.kc.test for tests/e2e  supabase/seed/e2e/load.sql
#   all         the three above, in that order
#   demo        the demo-data tools behind the admin portal's Demo data screen (FR-ADMIN-031):
#               supabase/seed/demo/load.sql installs them and marks kc-dev as the one database
#               where a restore may run. No demo data is created: an admin presses "Show demo
#               data" in the portal. Every dev deploy runs the same script (deploy-db.yml), so
#               this action is only for installing them between deploys. Not part of `all`.
#   vault       validate the two existing Vault secrets without changing either
#               (kc_project_url, kc_service_role_key), never printed or changed. Not
#               part of `all`. Missing or different values need a separately reviewed repair.
#
# Every seed is idempotent, so running one again changes nothing that is already loaded. The
# Hebrew demo dataset (members, posts, rides, chats, follows, [DEMO] nonprofits) is created and
# deleted from the portal once the `demo` action has installed its tools.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      action:
        description: 'which seed to load'
        type: choice
        options: [all, reference, content, e2e-users, demo, vault]
        default: all

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  seed:
    name: seed kc-dev · ${{ inputs.action }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    environment: supabase-dev
    env:
      SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
      SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF }}
      # Read by psql; never written to a file or a command line.
      PGPASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD }}
      KC_DEV_REF: enbqriuxvvuontiwslun
      ACTION: ${{ inputs.action }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Guard – dev project only
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" != "$KC_DEV_REF" ]; then
            echo "::error::supabase-dev SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF is not kc-dev; refusing."; exit 1
          fi

      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc

      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-supabase-cli

      # `supabase link` records the pooler address of the project (no password in it).
      - name: Retrieve and authenticate Vault key (vault action only)
        if: inputs.action == 'vault'
        run: node scripts/deploy-service-key.mjs --prepare dev

      - name: Link to kc-dev
        run: supabase link --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" --yes >/dev/null

      - name: Validate existing Vault caller and URL without changes
        if: inputs.action == 'vault'
        run: node scripts/deploy-service-key.mjs --verify-existing dev

      - name: Load the seeds
        if: inputs.action != 'vault'
        env:
          E2E_SEED_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.E2E_SEED_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          url="$(cat supabase/.temp/pooler-url)"
          case "$url" in postgres*://*) ;; *) echo "::error::no pooler address recorded by supabase link"; exit 1 ;; esac
          case "$url" in *"$KC_DEV_REF"*) ;; *) echo "::error::pooler address is not kc-dev's; refusing."; exit 1 ;; esac
          if [ "$ACTION" = all ] || [ "$ACTION" = reference ]; then
            echo "── reference ──"
            REFERENCE_DB_URL="$url" supabase/seed/reference/load.sh
          fi
          if [ "$ACTION" = all ] || [ "$ACTION" = content ]; then
            echo "── content ──"
            CONTENT_DB_URL="$url" supabase/seed/content/load.sh
          fi
          if [ "$ACTION" = all ] || [ "$ACTION" = e2e-users ]; then
            echo "── e2e users ──"
            [ -n "${E2E_SEED_PASSWORD:-}" ] || { echo "::error::E2E_SEED_PASSWORD secret is not set"; exit 1; }
            {
              echo "select set_config('kc.seed_target', 'dev', false), set_config('kc.seed_password', :'pw', false) \gset"
              cat supabase/seed/e2e/load.sql
            } | psql "$url" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v pw="$E2E_SEED_PASSWORD" -qAt -f -
          fi
          if [ "$ACTION" = demo ]; then
            echo "── demo data tools ──"
            psql "$url" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --single-transaction -qAt \
              -c "select set_config('kc.seed_target', 'dev', false)" -f supabase/seed/demo/load.sql
          fi

      # The vault action now validates only. Repair/bootstrap requires a separate
      # reviewed procedure; this manual workflow cannot bypass preservation.

      - name: Remove temporary verified credential
        if: always()
        run: rm -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/kc-verified-service-key"
